title: Sportico副主编：22岁天才球员，未来十年统治联盟？
speaker: Evan Novi Williams

segments.en: dominant and freakish athletes, maybe the NBA has ever seen.
segments.zh: 可能是NBA史上最具统治力和天赋的运动员。

segments.en: And getting these reps when he's 22 probably makes him better when he's 24 or 25.
segments.zh: 22岁就积累这些经验，很可能让他在24、25岁时更出色。

segments.en: You forget how young these players are because we've seen them for years and they just read so much older, especially when they're in these press conferences, like 22, come on.
segments.zh: 你会忘记这些球员有多年轻，因为我们看了他们好几年，他们在发布会上显得老成，其实才22岁。

segments.en: Victor, we've been hearing about for, it feels like for a decade out of the straight because he's been a prospect for so long, but yeah, it does highlight how much more basketball we're going to see him play over the next 10, 15 years.
segments.zh: 维克托，我们感觉已经听说他十年了，因为他作为新秀被关注了很久，但这确实凸显了未来10到15年我们还会看他打多少篮球。
